, PRAYING TO  ENLARGE THE PETITIONER ON BAIL IN THE EVENT OF HIS  ARREST IN CR.NO.131/2023 REGISTERED BY  -2-  NC: 2023:KHC:40227
CRL.P No. 10715 of 2023 SOLADEVANAHALLI POLICE STATION, BENGALURU
FOR THE OFFENCE P/U/S 498A, 323, 506 R/W 34 OF IPC AND SECTION 3 AND 4 OF DOWRY PROHIBITION ACT, PENDING ON THE FILE OF C.J.M., BENGALURU RURAL DISTRICT.

THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER Accused No.1 in Crime No.313/2023 registered by Soladevanahalli Police Station, Bengaluru City for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323 and 506 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (hereinafter referred to as 'IPC' for short) and under Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 is before this Court seeking anticipatory bail.
2.
Heard the learned counsel for the parties.

3. On the basis of the complaint dated 19.09.2023 by Ambika who is the wife of the petitioner herein, FIR in Crime No.313/2023 was registered by Soladevanahalli Police Station, Bengaluru City for the aforesaid offences against the petitioner and 4 others.

Apprehending arrest in the said case the petitioner had filed NC: 2023:KHC:40227 Crl.Misc.P.No.2022/2023 before the Court of VIII Addl. District and Sessions Judge, Bengaluru Rural District, Bengaluru which was dismissed on 30.09.2023.

entities.text: Court of VIII Addl. District and Sessions Judge, Bengaluru Rural District, Bengaluru
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Therefore, he is before this Court.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner having reiterated the grounds in the petition submits that omnibus allegations are made against the petitioner and his relatives.
The alleged offences are triable by Court of law and maximum punishment for the alleged offences is imprisonment for three years.
Accordingly, he prays to allow the petition.
5. Per contra, the learned HCGP has opposed the bail application.
6. The material on record will go to show that marriage of the petitioner and complainant had taken place on 17.05.2019 and from the said wedlock they have a male child.
It appears that there is serious difference of opinion between the couple and they have been fighting NC: 2023:KHC:40227 on petty issues.
In the complaint omnibus allegations are made against the petitioner and his relatives.
The alleged offences are triable by Court of Magistrate and maximum punishment for the alleged offences is imprisonment for three years.
The petitioner has no criminal antecedents.

sentences.text: Under these circumstances, I am of the view that the petitioner has made out a case for grant of anticipatory bail.

Accordingly, the following:
ORDER The Criminal Petition is allowed.

The respondent - Police or any other police in the State of Karnataka are directed to release the petitioner in the event of his arrest in Crime No.313/2023 registered by Soladevanahalli Police Station, Bengaluru City for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323 and 506 read with Section 34 of IPC and under Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961, subject to the following conditions:
NC: 2023:KHC:40227 1.

The Petitioner shall appear before the Investigating Officer within 15 days from the date of receipt of the copy of this order and shall execute a personal bond for a sum of Rs.1,00,000/-(One lakh only) with two sureties for the likesum to the satisfaction of the investigating officer.
2. Petitioner shall regularly appear before the Trial Court without fail unless exempted by the Trial Court for valid reasons.
3. Petitioner shall not tamper with the prosecution witness and he shall co-operate with the police for investigation and appear before them whenever called upon.
4. The petitioner shall not involve in similar offences in future.

Sd/-
